name: hatch-codogotchi
description: Codex-native skills that draw Codogotchi-compatible sprite atlases (Codex, Lite-Basic, Lite-Enhanced, and Son-of-Anton tiers) from a seed image, a text description, or an existing Codex sheet.

interface.longDescription: Hatch Codogotchi bundles five guided, sheet-first skills plus a Python pipeline (prepare → slice 3x3 row sheets → stitch → inspect → compose → validate) for producing Codogotchi-compatible WebP sprite atlases: the required Codex Tier-1 sheet, the Lite-Basic and Lite-Enhanced alive/dead tiers, and the Son-of-Anton delivery-gate sheet. Start from a seed image, a text description, or an existing Codex spritesheet.
defaultPrompt: Hatch a new Codogotchi pet from this seed image
Add the Lite-Basic spritesheet to my existing Codex pet
Generate the Son-of-Anton gate spritesheet for my pet
